collection_methods.primary: Elsevier Scopus Search API (X-ELS-APIKey) - ISSN(0144-8617), sort=-coverDate, 8 pages x 25 = 200 entries scanned
collection_methods.deprecated_endpoints: content/search/scidir returns HTTP 410 Gone (retired); content/search/sciencedirect and Abstract/Article Retrieval full-text return 401/403 (no entitlement for abstract text / full text with this API key)
collection_methods.dedup_crosscheck: PubMed ESearch (Publisher ID / [AID] field) used to map Scopus DOIs to PMIDs, preventing double-counting of the same article under different identifier namespaces (pii: vs pmid:) already present in seen_articles.json
collection_methods.pubmed_supplement: PubMed E-utilities ESearch/EFetch (Carbohydr Polym[ta] AND Journal Article[pt] NOT Review[pt], reldate=90) - 440 results, 0 new (all already in seen_articles.json) - contributed 0 new articles this run
collection_methods.author_and_date_enrichment: CrossRef API (api.crossref.org/works/{doi}) for full author lists and online publication ('created') date
collection_methods.abstract_supplement: WebSearch used for the 12 keyword-focused articles (cellulose/pectin/hydrogel) to verify author-matched public preprints (e.g. SSRN) or related work where possible, since no abstract text was accessible via Elsevier/PubMed/CrossRef/Semantic Scholar for these very recent (not-yet-PubMed-indexed) articles
